overview: The Envoy Reception Hall is the ceremonial and diplomatic gateway to Shar Vahl’s palace.
history: The hall was built to formalize clan envoy access to the palace.
Foreign emissaries were granted structured reception protocols.
Clan insignia banners were added to represent Shar Vahl’s unity.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the hall was expanded with new alcoves.
Shadow-Threat Watch established a discreet observation post here.
hooks: A clan envoy arrives with urgent news from the outer regions.
A ceremonial greeting is disrupted by a hazard flare.
A foreign emissary requests immediate audience with the palace.
A diplomatic dispute escalates into a heroic event.
